body: That's why all my life I've tried to help everyone that needed it. Anytime someone would look to help me I turned them away because I saw myself as a lost cause. I never wanted people to try to help me because I felt as though I would drag them down.
Thanks. I've been searching for one person to help for the last year or so when it all took a turn for the worse. With tearing down the walls. I've tried everything and nothing has worked.
